thought the food here was very good, but my gripe was with the service.  when my entree came out, i ordered a beer to go with it.  unfortunately, i didn't get that beer until i had finished eating.  i ordered the prime rib which was great, but the wedge salad was my favorite part of the meal.  i'd give this place 3.5 stars if i could because of the service, but i'll round up because of the food.  i'm hoping the service is fixed and am giving them the benefit of the doubt because they just opened.

I wish I could pack this place up and take it home with me. Great drinks, great food, and great staff. Atmosphere is kick-ass too! The food is basically modern interpretations of southern comfort food (and vegetarian friendly for my fellow veggies out there). Though it's a secret I kind of want to keep to myself, I can't give this place enough love.

Just moved to Nashville from Chicago 2 years ago. Wanted so much to love the pizza here but have several bad experience.  Some with the staff and some with the food.  The last order was the biggest disappointment.  Ordered the deep dish with spinach and the spinach on the pizza was burnt.  When I open the box the spinach looked black and sure enough when I tried it, all I could taste was burnt spinach.  Another experience was a thin crust with sausage and mushroom.  Pizza had no mushroom and very little sausage.  This was after they messed up my order to begin with and I had to wait an additional 35 minutes.  The combo sandwich my husband ordered did not have italian sausage on it but polish sausage.  Trust me he would know the difference.  The pizza isn't cheap so at this point I would rather pay less for bad pizza.

everything was ON POINT. I had the sonora dog which I absolutely loved. The mango marguerita was amazing and hit the spot perfectly. I also had the carne asada caramelos were a hit. Too bad I live in LA because I would go back for their food any day. 

I would have docked them a star just for their dumb hostess with her dumb attitude, but the food more than made up for it. The server we had was great though.

I guess if you like natural flavorless smoothies this is the place to go. The smoothies didn't taste bad but they just didn't taste good. I ended up throwing mine away because I couldn't get by the after taste of every sip, which to me tasted like...tree or grass.

Howl is so much fun! I've been to the location in Boston and this is the perfect addition to the Philly night scene. It took over Bucca de Beppo's lot so it's pretty spacious. Depending on your arrival time you may have to wait in line, but it moves quickly. There's a $5 cover but during their opening month they have a coupon on their Facebook page for free admission. The performers were awesome, but as the first review said they're more like a cover band than dueling pianos. Regardless, very entertaining and a ton of fun to dance and sing along. The area in front of the stage is really loud and gets pretty hot, but the rest of the bar is fine. The drinks were expensive and not strong, which was disappointing. The speciality drink there is the huge bucket of booze, meant to serve 4 people. Tasty, but again, not strong enough. 

If you're looking to sing and dance the night away, come to Howl!

One of the worst experiences of my entire life.  I was stranded in a dark parking lot, by myself, and I am a woman over 50. This is a very, very scary thing to be stranded alone in a dark parking lot.  I called Progressive Roadside Assistance, and they dispatched Big Dave's Towing.  Short story long, things went terribly wrong. A tow truck drove by and did not stop. I contacted Progressive, got patched through to Big Dave's.  Keep in mind I'm scared to death at the time.  Instead of being helpful, they screamed obscenities at me, and then the PURPOSEFULLY endangered my life by telling me that they decided to cancel the call because I was so frightened and scared and they did not want to deal with a frightened woman.

Fortunately, their driver decided to come anyway.  His truck was bigger, and a different color, than the one that had driven by earlier.  He was helpful, professional, and very pleasant to work with.  I wish I could say that the story had a happy ending, but it does not.

While I was waiting I called up a friend and she stayed on the line with me until the first tow truck drove by. After I got home I called her back.  She immediately called Big Dave's Towing and was told, "We don't care if she had gotten raped or not.  She would have deserved it."

What kind of monsters are the people who run Big Dave's Towing?  TO WISH THAT I HAD BEEN RAPED, BEATEN, OR EVEN KILLED BECAUSE I WAS STRANDED IN A DARK PARKING LOT, AT NIGHT, AND SCARED TO DEATH, IS BEYOND LOW.  IT IS PURE EVIL!

I went Marakkesh with my friend. I am really amazed with the atmosphere and delicious Moroccan food. 
I live in NY butI never tasted such a good food. 

The folks and personnel are really good and they love their work,

When I ate the Chicken and lamb with my friend, the degree of happiness was at the highest.

GO THERE WITH A FRIEND AND SHARE HAPPINESS BY ENJOYING THE FOOD

I am gluten and yeast intolerant, so I was in heaven when I found this place. Not only did they have all my normal foods, but I found flax seed pizza dough and vegan cupcakes that were divine. Everything was laid out easy to find. I am now a regular!

This place always has what I need. I've been to Whole Foods, but they don't provide a lot of options for gluten free diners. I have been to Rollin Oats at least once a week to get items for my kitchen. 

I can get Quinoa pasta which is the best gluten free pasta out there in my book, and they have sales occasionally so you can stock up. They also have vegan cheese since I'm lactose intolerant. This is also relatively well priced. 

Overall I find this store to be the only one in the vicinity that truly suits my needs.

I keep coming back here, and it keeps being impeccable. I'll admit, I was a skeptic, mostly because of that fact that Han Dynasty has become a chain throughout Philly, and deserved or not, operations which open up multiple locations can have a reputation for slacking on standards. If they have at Han Dynasty's University City locations, I think my mind might explode.

The interior is really pleasant, and has a very hip vibe. It's a great place to drop in for lunch, and I've never had to wait long for a table. I would go on about the menu, but I've yet to see anything which I would tell people to avoid. You'll notice at the table that there isn't any sauces or salt and pepper, and that's because everything I've gotten has been properly seasoned before it has arrived. The place is great for groups, as the dishes have been designed for sharing. Do it, do it, do it!

i stayed here for five nights including new years eve and I had a great time. It's a Great place to stay, the staff were friendly. They have a social hour on select nights with FREE wines, beers and a nice hot meal. It's one of the best deals in town plus the location is perfect for tourists.

Hotel was pretty clean, rooms were decent size, sheets were not clean. Had a problem with Internet, was told that Internet was per room after paying we were then told it was per device. We had to argue for quite sometime but after talking to manager problem was resolved. Parking is really expensive and garage is "under construction" very unsafe.

Kelp sushi delivered some tasty sushi rolls. I ate the spicy tuna and California rolls. Both were tasty with large pieces of fresh fish within each roll. Ordered takeout over the phone and used a coupon code for $10 off. The order was packed neatly with the rolls tightly wrapped in waxed paper rather than plastic containers. The decor inside was hip and trendy. I would go back with a group and try out more dishes!

On a scale from good to Indian, this place scored a good.  It has a nice ambiance and the buffet has a good selection.  The food was heavy and the flavors are good for arizona, but not really good for Indian food in it's original form.  If you need a fix the buffet will get you in and out fast. Good for AZ.
Their massaman beef and coconut rice are great, flavourful dishes. The beef is tender. Service is fast and friendly.

I agree with the fast friendly service. Just stopped by for a quick carry-out and was pleasantly surprised. I was in and out in record time. 
Once I got home and unwrapped my treasures, I saw the portion size... yay... jackpot for someone like me who likes to pig out...
I had the grilled beef bahn mi and it was excellent. I may order that without the jalapenos since they are quite  strong and fiery. Otherwise the taste is just wonderful. 
Also ordered the vermicelli with beef, which was quite big and equally tasty. 
Yes, I will be back to discover more items on their menu.
Came here for their lunch buffet. Only $8? Yes, please! Staff is friendly. Food is good. Eat here.

Extensive menu and they were pretty busy for a weeknight.  They have a nice private roomFor use and lots of sports decor as expected,  this new location still has some work to do, pretty average sports bar.  House wine was fine but the wings came out much hotter than they were supposed to, even the second time around.  Their bbque sauce is spicy. Service was pretty good.  Nothing terribly special going on here.

We did a dinner cruise. Unfortunately, we picked the one day of our trip with 2 waves of thunderstorms during our cruise!  the jazz band, and passengers, were literally blown off the decks.  Also, we were expecting cajun buffet, but that was not what was served.  We met a lovely couple from Scotland as we huddled on deck.  We would actually give this another try, but would probably opt for the cruise only and would skip dinner.  The short time we got to enjoy the jazz band on deck before the storm blew in was Fantastic!!

So, outside of Mark in NYC, these were the best sliders I've ever had. Add in amazing donuts and it's frankly a bit surprising that I ever left. I'm not typically a fan of the burger/donut combo, but the Croque Monsieur was pretty awesome. Also, the guys serving us were extremely friendly, which was a nice change from your typical hipsteresque spot.

So slow... Waited at the bar to be seated. 30 minutes later we sat down. We waited another 15 minutes to actually stop another waiter to ask for a waiter. She helped us an directed us to another person which we basically had to stop to take our order. The service is unbelievable for what I'm paying. I haven't even gotten the food an I'm so unhappy... So somewhere else!!!

This is the worst tanning salon ever.  Beware!  They tell you everything is included in the membership, but when you want to use a service you have to pay extra.  Then if there is an issue, nobody will return calls and they will do anything to keep charging you.  They try to upsell you everytime you walk in the door!  I'm so happy I cancelled my membership.

Amazing! Delicious! I love Bailey's Range! First tried it a few months ago after moving downtown and I was very impressed. I love that all of their meats are grass-fed and all of their beer is supplied by local breweries. I have been back multiple times and have never been disappointed. The only thing I would change would be to make the burgers bigger. They're a little on the small side. I definitely recommend this restaurant!

If you're after a unique experience, best look elsewhere. If, however, all that you require is a pleasant, clean place to sit and have a reasonably priced meal you should be fine. 

The drip coffee was surprisingly good. Menu selection is reasonable. This is essentially a fairly well-done (if generic, inoffensive) chain restaurant with just the smallest bit of flair when it comes to decor and menu. 

Keep expectations in check and if you're looking for exotic (and expensive) I recommend milktooth (it's amazing).

I made a reservation online 2 or 3 days prior, then the day of I called to confirm.  No problem.  It was a business dinner with clients, I wanted to show them a bit of history of Reno, and according to Yelp; good reviews.

I would give a zero for the service, in particular the 20 something girl at the front.  She is useless, and if that is the first face you see coming in - forget it.  I will never setup another business dinner or lunch there because of this young lady.  She argued, said there was no reservation, rolled her eyes, looked bored, wasn't helpful, and then when all was said and done the reservation WAS there, but she didn't "see" it.  Meanwhile the people are piling up at the door!  

Now are they SO busy on a week night that they can afford to turn a party of 8 away?  Are there really no tables available?  Really?  Or, is the hostess lazy and didn't want to do her JOB?!!  

Never going back, never going to recommend.

Affordable Plumbing is Ultra Professional! 
They call back right away, the times I have used them they arrived earlier then they advertised. Their prices work with your budget, they work fast, they don't need to guess about what the problem is and avoid the wrong fix. When they have serviced our apartment building, we have not needed to call them back for the same problem.

AAAA++++ Highly Recommend!
Best sushi I've had in a VERY long time. Service was awesome and they offer bottomless rolls!
Best Indian food in Boise, bar none. Interesting atmosphere, fresh ingredients, lunch buffet every day. Varied menu. Large selection of beer.

I thought this place was a little stuffy and loaded with tourists. They even made me take off my hat in the dining room(a fedora) but let in 2 jackasses in shorts and flip flops. 
Service was good but it was all too much for my liking. They do make a mean sauzerac. 
We did the prie fixe. Started with Redfish cake(great) and soup of the day(meh). The pork chop was huge and delicious. Seafood stew was alright. Bread pudding was great as was the butterscotch pudding.
Wine pours a bit skimpy for my taste and wasn't a fan of their by the glass offerings.
This was pretty good. I was looking for some Mexican food and found it. Large portions and it came out relatively quick.

Fun breakfast choices (including vegetarian and low carb friendly) with flair, friendly service. Great people watching on the Monon trail if you choose outdoor seating. What's not to love?

New to me(Apr 2014)! - Fresh fried donut holes, generously sized. Share an order as a 'breakfast appetizer'!
Food is ok. They had good Italian sandwiches. Takes a long time to get your food. The place is old looking and could use a remodel. Overall I would come back but its not on the top of my list.

Love this place, love the al pastor tacos, taco Tuesday was so good! $1.50 each taco..awesome deal! My friend got the quesadilla with mushroom and rajas, spicy but really good. The tortillas are amazing, I love this place

Definitely a little divey and could probably use a really good deep cleaning, but I liked the Pines Tavern. Our server was friendly and accommodating and there when we needed her.  My Tavern burger special was tasty, but the burger itself was smaller than expected for $9. Overall, a good first experience. Will try again.

Great service - fixed an amp I thought wasn't worth bothering with for next to nothing - in a couple of hours to boot!
I didn't have a look at much of the merchandise but it looked like cool used stuff and plenty of new accessories  (sticks, heads, strings, cables, etc). My guess is this is the best mom and pop store in Nola.

This is my favorite place for a greasy burger, and I mean that in a good way. Big, juicy, and cooked to perfection, this is where I come when I don't want fast food or something that tastes like it came from a chain restaurant. I've also tried the barbecue and it was excellent. Service isn't fast, and that's ok as that's not why I eat there. Staff is always friendly and attentive. One thing to keep in mind is they only take cash or check, no credit cards (that's how it's been when I go, I'm sure that will change at some point).

Finally got around to this place, after a busy Saturday. Came in and we were seated within 10 minutes , which came to a surprise because the place was packed. Sat down and looked over the menu and decided that I could not possibly pass up the Queso and Guac dip. This was definitely a good choice since the guac was super fresh and the queso was cheesetacular. My only regret was getting the riesling instead of a beer for this meal. My main dish was hard to choose because they had so much to pick from, though  was finally able to decide on the short rib grilled cheese. The sandwich itself was okay, though once I found out they have given what seemed to be a horseradish aioli the dish went from a mediocre sandwich to a richly complex flavored dish that I could not stop eating. In the end the meal was a solid one and my only pique would be that even though we were seated fairly quickly the service was a bit slow. It was a very crowded Saturday so I cannot complain overly much. To sum up as one other reviewer said, this place is like the cheesecake factory without the wait and that is far from a bad thing.

As a member of the Southern Arizona Concierge Network, I was dining at this El Charro location this past week. The decor and ambiance was fabulous, the servers were so very attentive, and the food was delicious! Their Sangria is to die for!! I have been at their other locations several times and this store did not disappoint!
Don't buy if you need delivery and don't have weeks to wait.  Horrible, they give no guarantee and don't care once they get there money.  Don't buy here.

I admit our expectations were high (best children's museum in the world), but we've been to many children's museums and found this one to be good but not great.  Every children's museum needs a large play city (see Tampa, Cleveland, and Dayton museums) and that was lacking here.  Although the museum and exhibits were large, they didn't really seem to spark the imagination as well as COSI in Columbus.  Also, no reciprocal memberships from other children's museums are accepted.  For those to the East, I'd recommend the Boonshoft museum in Dayton.

Uncommonly cool food. Extremely forward thinking and trendy, this relatively new Irish Channel hot spot brings flavor and nuance to an hip community with no pretensions. The artwork and seating arrangements is very inviting. With a great environment to match the laid back lifestyle of the neighborhood, its the perfect place to drop in at random and find no disappointment. 

The donuts are an exceptional presentation of colors and variety, redefining the old conception of the coffee-soaker, deep fried breakfast replacement. Not unlike high end French pastries, the variety of flavors and concoctions is experimental and innovative. Try the maple sriracha. Time and time again, it blows my mind away as one of the most original pastry ideas I've ever come across. 

Their sliders are a hunger cure. Try three different ones every time you come, and you'll probably never have the same combination more than once. Going with the regular selection is a great idea, but don't miss out on selections like beef belly or bulgogi with Kim-chi. 

The staff is extremely gracious and they keep the place very clean, always servicing the huge espresso machine. On that note, they will weigh your espresso before and after brewing to provide the best acidity, all grains coming form Atlanta's 1000 Faces. 

Grab some beer next door at steins and walk over and enjoy. Or grab some donuts and go over to steins for beer. Whatever way you do it, this is a happening weekend spot. 

I look forward to coming here for a long time.

Had the Creole House Shrimp Po Boy, Fried Alligator, and the Caramel Waffle Apple Sunday.  All of it was phenomenal.  Our server was great.  If I'm ever in New Orleans again, I would absolutely come back.  Very cool place.

The restaurant is located in the corner of a strip mall. I ordered fajitas steak and what I was served was the cheapest meat they could pass as steak, by no means was it close to skirt steak. One thing I didn't like for the price was the cheese selection. Mexican Restaurant should serve Mexican cheese, such as fresco or cotija. Instead they serve fajitas with kraft shredded cheddar mix ( I wouldn't even say kraft... best value brand). This food was not authentic and at best mediocre. I wouldn't recommend, but if you end up there it's not torture. I think they need to pay attention to the value of ingredients!

Excellent! They have the best hamburgers in all of New Orleans. However, after saying that be prepared. It's nearly impossible to bite into the burger due to how large it is, but it's well worth it and the price is reasonable ($10.81-total without cheese and it comes with your choice of fries or onion rings). The burger consists of delicious large, thick and juicy burger meat inside a large sesame seed bun which also includes two thick-cut slices of tomato, a thick slice of onion and lots of lettuce and pickles and your choice of condiments. The fries are large, but I usually get their tasty onion rings. Their drive-thru is fast and I live about three blocks from a Metarie location so I like to stop by from time-to-time on the way home from work and eat the meal at home. It's funny, but everytime I order one of their burgers I can't help but think of what an insult it is to the hamburger that places like Burger King or McDonalds and other fast food places offer (dog food on a bun). The shrimp basket is another story... Delicious, but a bit pricey if you get the onion rings to go along with it. Whatever you order I'm sure you won't regret it!

You like a delicious breakfast? THIS is your place! I had a great brunch with 5 friends and we definitely were happy campers! There are do many choices, we all ordered different dishes and shared. We left happy, full, and with some food for the road. We'd definitely return here if we find out way to Nashville again

My friends and I just call this "Fancy Schnucks." The grocery store itself is gorgeous, and its selection cannot be beat. 

But really, this review is for the brunch. Have you been to the brunch?? It's on the mezzanine, and both times I've been it's been nearly deserted. This is a mystery to me. At $19.95 it's a little pricey, but it's a huge buffet with included adult beverage and fresh hot beignets plus waffles made to order. Housemade sausages, local produce, fresh baked goods- I can't say enough good things about this brunch.

Two of us sat at the bar at 8:00 on a Tuesday night, not very busy... and the service was super slow. Waited a few minutes for a bartender to return to the bar. We were finally given drink menus then waited another 10 minutes, (then watched the 2nd/3rd round drinks go out for others at the bar), before we were able to give our 1st round orders. We then asked for food menus. Weren't ready at the first attempt to take our orders and the second attempt was a pretty good while after that. Food, (5 hot n spicy wings @ 50 cents a piece, and a cheddar veggie burger with fries), took over a half an hour. Positives that made this a 3-star rating instead of less: 

1) Food was still hot and enjoyable. It was tasty upper level bar food; though nothing that I'd rave about.

2) Our bartender and other staff we interacted with (hostess and other bartender) were very nice; bartender was talkative but not too attached. She gave great suggestions when I asked about two different app options. She also remembered the lemon for my water (somehow always a big deal to me...it's the little things)! Then when it took a long time for her to bring our check she acknowledged it and apologized for the wait. 

And...

3) Great mixed drinks that were worth the wait!

Overall a great, "happy hour with co-workers" spot.

My brother took me to Philadelphia Archery and Gun Club for my first gun shooting experience.  He's a member here and has tried many of the shooting ranges around and in the city.  He brought along a 9mm and a rifle, an sks? or something.  I don't know I think it was of the Russian assault variety.  He gave me a lot of information in a short period of time and I mostly retained the stuff I needed to know immediately.  

We arrived and were greeted by some lackluster staff that had me show ID and fill out a form before directing us upstairs.  To be fair it was after 7:30 and they close up around 8:30 or 9.  The upstairs gentleman, Mike, was really nice.  He liked my name and said it reminded him of something from Sherlock Holmes or Hopalong Cassidy and then proceeded to show me his dvd case for Hopalong Cassidy.  It was weird but I liked it.   I don't know what would happen if I had gone here without a member or someone skilled with guns so I can't say much about the staff on that level but nice is nice.  It was $5 for me to shoot since I was with a member, apparently Wednesday is ladies night and ladies shoot free so keep that in mind if you were blessed with girly parts. 

The range is smallish, with about eight or so lanes.  Each is equipped with a target holder and controls for moving your target.  My brother brought zombie targets but the range has targets (for sale I think) if you need them.  According to my brother the ammunition is a little pricey but I don't know much about that.  I don't know that I'd go back and shoot again but it was a cool experience and I can scratch it off of my list.
This place was cool, on our first trip out too philly we stopped by this whole little area and it's pretty amazing to see all the history

We stopped in for lunch. We started with the Crawfish Beignet, which is really not so much a Beignet, but excellent none the less. I had a Cajun Cuban with red beans and rice. The Cuban was OK, but far from the best I have had, and the red beans and rice were pretty good also, but not great. My wife had the Drum Crab Stacker which was really quite good. It was drum fish (which was very good), stacked with fried green tomato and a crawfish sauce. Service was great, and lots of great sounding items on the menu in a cozy atmosphere. Really liked it and will be back when in NOLA.

The selection of calzones are very impressive. Went with a group and we shared each other's calzones. They were all excellent. Saw huge salads being served to other tables that looked amazing. The only thing that would have made it 5 stars was the soda selection. No Coke or Pepsi products on the fountain. All the selections were gross. This place needs to nut-up and get a Coke Freestyle machine. Save the goofy sodas for bottles only. Stop doing the hipster fad.

Gross permutations of ramen. I would just go traditional with the ramen joint in China town. This is coming from someone who has been to ramen places in Tokyo and Fukuoka. I don't understand the hype about this place. 

Whatever you do, do not order the cold ramen. I tried it and it was absolutely awful.
Very disappointed.

This place came highly recommended by friends. After a morning of driving, I was ready to devour some amazing food. The boozy milkshake stole the show. My husband had a milkshake without alcohol, which was also stupid good. The fries and the homemade sauces were also delicious. I wish the fries were a bit warmer, but hey, fries are fries! We both got burgers. When looking at the menu, we thought the amount of ingredients would = a ton of flavor, but that wasn't the case. Both burgers, cooked medium, were just okay. Not a ton of flavor, nothing special. They were both beef, so if we went back Id try one of the other meats. All in all, the milkshakes alone are a reason to check this place out!

This is a casual pizza joint.  I needed a little something heartier than a slice of pizza, so I ordered the Veggie Roll.  I'm not sure what makes it a roll rather than a calzone other than it's shape, but it was delicious.  Their marinara is delicious, so I bet their pizza is awesome.  The veggies in the Veggie Roll were all fresh, not frozen or canned, and I always appreciate that.  The staff was friendly enough and my food was cooked really fast.  There weren't a lot of people in there, though, so I don't know how the wait is when it's packed.  I'll definitely be back to try the pie!

It's and ok burger is good but it's one of those things after you eat you feel disgusting like why did I eat that. I've have some good tasty burgers they didn't make me feel so bad afterwards. Three stars because they provide and excellent milkshake. I wouldn't recommend going if you don't plan on getting a shake. All of them have turned out good. My husband enjoyed the tater tots.

This McDonald's don't taste like the others
And i haven't ate a McDonalds in almost a year...
Until now.....thank u

Went here for a concert this last weekend and let me just say that Plush is not plush at all.  It was one of the worst experiences of my life.  I paid $25 for a ticket so I could stand in a very dark, hot room crowded by a bunch of people. There is very limited seating and most of that is on the upper level. Not sure if you pay extra or have to get there early.  There was no air circulation and the acoustics were horrendous.

It is basically a warehouse with a concrete floor.  If you come here, bring earplugs and comfortable shoes otherwise you will leave early like we did hot, sweaty and half deaf. 

Also you will pay about $10 for parking on a lot since street parking is at a premium in this area of midtown.

We did not eat here. They do have cider on tap which was a bonus for my friend who doesn't drink beer.

The four stars I am giving Maynards are for the cocktail I had, a delectable libation combining crushed blackberries and whiskey. 

Potent, sexy and pretty to look at, it melded beautifully with the chic surroundings of Maynard's on a Friday night. Add to this a wild monsoon and you have a cinematic start to a night out.

The passing plates looked divine but I can't attest to their delish factor because all we did was drink. Next time Maynard, next time.
This place is walking distance to my office and the lunch prices are pocket friendly! But the food it's really not so great. Bland and unappealing. I would recommend Thai Kitchen in Maryland Heights!
Great addition to 54th street! This cute little shop is full of unique gifts and home decor. They have everything from candles to furniture, at a variety of price points.

Very cool atmosphere in Philly! We came here on a weekend and the wait was going to be over an hour. We came back during the week and there was still a wait for a table but the bar was open. Honestly we probably had more fun sitting at the bar than if we had a table. I got the veggie burger and my BF got a regular bacon cheese burger. He enjoyed his burger and ranked it in his top 5. I enjoyed the veggie burger and it was quite large, but I quite honestly was wishing for more sauciness or some moisture. I would not say that this was the best veggie burger I have had and for the price I was slightly disappointed. I did, however, immensely enjoy the tater tots! They were crispy on the outside and like mashed potatoes on the inside! Whatever sauce they give you to go with it was delicious as well! All-in-all, I enjoyed my dinner at the bar at Village Whiskey. It is a bit pricey, but if you can swing it I don't think you'll be disappointed!

Have been here 3 times and each time has been spot on. The spring rolls are HUGE. I like the rice paper they use and the shrimp ones are delicious along with the sauce they are served with. The egg rolls were okay, deep fried and standard, so I say go with the spring rolls- shrimp or beef to choose from. My friend always gets the #10 pho, but I branch out and have enjoyed my options each time. I say go for the sandwiches!! They are on the smaller size but they are cheap and tasty. Very fresh veggies and ingredients. The music is tranquil and the lady is super friendly.

This bakery makes magnificent cakes! They are moist, rich, and delicious! I have purchased the almond cake, the gingerbread cake, and a butterscotch cake. Each one was delightful! I highly recommend the gingerbread cake for any holiday gathering! It is a masterpiece!

This is, hands down, my favorite place for breakfast, ever.  There food is truly incredible and very well thought out and executed.  Their hollandaise sauce can not be topped by any other restaurant, and it's different every time you go in there.  

Great for families, kids under six "pay what they weigh", so a #30 kid gets to eat for 30 cents.  We honestly end up paying less to eat hear than McDonalds, and there is no comparison when it comes to the food.

The service is the best.  The hostess knows to put us with Bob before we even open the door, but all the people there are great.  

I have been coming here for over 6 years and have never been disappointed.

my friend and I had reservations and were seated in the last seat on a busy Wednesday night. There was a great 5 piece band playing and it didn't overwhelm the acoustics. The main problem was service...we sat there for 15 minutes as server after server passed us by with no eye contact, and when the server finally came to us our closely seated neighbor bogarted him and out in a drink order and some more food before we could even order a cocktail. You would think that he would have turned and taken our order but it want another ten minutes until he returned and I had given up and gone for cocktails already...which I was happy I did because the bartender out on quite a show of talent in preparing the drinks! The tapas were good, especially the noodles. Eclectic menu, excellent drinks-just don't forget to pack your patience:)
We had 4 different items from the menu and they were all delicious.  Michael our server was excellent.

The server was very nice. The patio was clean (although there were alot of bug bites).  Really not a nice place to enjoy a view.  The food was very bland. Too bad. This could be a nice place but the food is not worth a return trip. I suggest going elsewhere for Italian food.

Best friendliest employees that know the menu. Fantastic antipasatas! I love this place... the vibe, the food, service, patio, and the bar. One tiny complaint is the kitchen is a tad heavy handed with salt and i love salt but sometimes you gotta dial back in riva... still 5 stars. Seriously great service.

I'm visiting my old hometown Philadelphia from NYC for a conference and decided to stop by here for dinner after the next door Olive Garden had me and everyone else in the bar area waiting for any sign of staff for over 5 minutes..but this was a blessing in disguise because I walked back to honeygrow and all I can say is wow this place is amazing! Super easy and fun to order exactly to your liking, and the end result is the most delicious and healthy stir fry you ever had (beats even stir fry sit down and order restaurants like stir crazy in quality, and I love stir crazy)!! And on top of that, the refreshing kale'ata is a nice deal and really hits the spot, and I can only imagine their trademark honeybar is even more nice and will be trying one when I come back tomorrow. Service/staff excellent as well. Only bad thing about honeygrow is now I'm totally disappointed that NYC doesn't have a place like this, nor have I found any of of the free multi-phone charging boxes at this place anywhere (perhaps just too deep a fear of loitering/Philly hospitality in NY?)

I admit, I have walked past this place about 20 times thinking it was a hipster/pretentious hang out. Finally the lady friend, convinced me to give it a chance (despite the sidewalk dj trying way too hard). The first thing I noticed was that every table inside had a reserved sign on it when we walked in at 9, yet no one was seated at these tables (when we left at 1030, two of those tables were occupied).

The bartender(s) were very friendly. We happened to be nerds on an old-fashioned cocktail pub crawl so ordered one here. Our bartender made us some hybrid between a bourbon based old-fashioned and mojito, and I will say this was one of the best drinks I have had. We had to continue our crawl to The Canopy so I couldn't have a second (as the crowd seemed to arrive), but I probably would come back here.

My only complaint (I can't comment on food) is that the dj, while live, wasn't very good. We later walked on over to The Canopy and enjoyed the music much more. That being said, I realize everyone has a different appreciation/taste in music. I love anything on Beach Dr and being close to the bay, and everyone working here seemed nice enough, so I plan on visiting again eventually.
